handoff_constraints: Treat statutory filing systems as authority-specific rails: require official endpoint/source refs, credential boundaries, payload schemas, payload digests, and agency acknowledgement/receipt evidence before runtime submission claims.
Keep agency credentials and live agency connections outside the review-only contract until certified provider/onboarding evidence exists.
Keep tax-payment/disbursement execution separate from filing evidence so a filing-readiness plan cannot imply funds movement.
Preserve legal-entity isolation and human approval as required controls for corporate payroll/accounting statutory submissions.

findings: Package, capability, changeset, and evidence names follow the enterprise-suite statutory-filing-evidence naming pattern.
Root operating contract, Enterprise Suite spec, task ledger, multispectrum evidence, and audit-chain conventions are preserved.
New control-plane crate is under crates/ and cloud-readiness composes it through a workspace path dependency.
The statutory evidence contract stays in a dedicated control-plane crate and cloud-readiness consumes only validated plan fields and capability flags.
No new external dependency is introduced; cloud-readiness adds one workspace path dependency.
Enterprise Suite JSON, catalog row, data_class annotations, and multispectrum evidence keep machine-readable shapes.
Validation is deterministic and bounded: requirement uniqueness, KR/US and rail-kind coverage, official authority URL allowlist, safe refs, required controls, and runtime overclaim flags are checked.
The slice is a small typed contract and validator; it adds no agency client, no payment execution, no durable archive, and no cloud runtime.

Filing readiness now requires official authority refs, payload digests, agency receipts, credential boundaries, legal-entity isolation, and human approval before cloud promotion can claim statutory filing rails.
Tests mutate missing requirements, duplicate requirement IDs, unofficial authority URLs, credential-shaped refs, missing controls, and runtime overclaim flags.
Future cloud/filing adapters get one typed evidence plan instead of discovering statutory prerequisites from payroll/accounting prose.
The crate uses typed enums, explicit errors, no unsafe, no network calls, and no third-party dependencies.

Alternatives considered: immediate filing API integration, broad prose-only checklist, or a review-only typed evidence contract. The typed contract was selected because it is verifiable now and avoids legal/runtime overclaims.
The contract references existing payroll/accounting statutory rulepack evidence and composes into cloud-readiness while leaving runtime submission and disbursement as blockers.
Agency credential refs are boundary refs only; tests reject credential-shaped secret/token/password payload refs and runtime credential attachment remains false.
Validation is O(number of filing requirements) over four static requirement rows and adds no request-path, network, or storage runtime work.
New statutory filing tests and cloud-readiness tests cover positive readiness, authority coverage, nonclaims, and negative overclaim/drift cases.

The contract strengthens compliance traceability for statutory filings while preserving production filing, agency credential, payment/disbursement, durable archive, and runtime audit evidence as explicit blockers.
Enterprise Suite spec, tasks, catalog row, evidence, and audit-chain rows document the statutory filing evidence plan and nonclaims.
The slice is additive and can be reverted by removing the new crate/catalog row and cloud-readiness dependency/fields.
The plan names payload digest and agency receipt evidence refs, but does not claim runtime telemetry or audit-chain emission.
Reserved facet not applicable; no special reserved-surface claim is made.
No data/schema migration is performed; agency credentials, live agency connections, runtime submission, payment execution, durable archive, and cloud deployment remain future migrations.

known_gaps: no durable business storage runtime attachment
no durable Workflow engine or broker execution
no production or multi-region SLO evidence
full oya verify --ci-required not claimed for the whole branch
nonclaims: This slice is a review-only statutory filing evidence contract foundation.

It does not prove statutory filing submission, agency acceptance, agency credential onboarding, payment/disbursement execution, durable statutory archiving, runtime audit-chain emission, or cloud deployment readiness.
summary: Adds an Enterprise Suite statutory filing evidence contract and composes it into cloud-readiness without claiming agency filing, disbursement, payment, archive, audit runtime, or cloud deployment.
